fact: The Council of Ministers heard on 26 October 2016 and the President approved by decree no. 2016-684 of 7 November 2016 the Declaration de Politique Sectorielle of the digital economy sector, its execution entrusted to the Minister of Digital Economy, the Minister of Finance and the Conseil du Numerique.
title: Decret n° 2016-684 du 07 novembre 2016 portant approbation de la Declaration de Politique Sectorielle du secteur de l'economie numerique
publisher: Presidence de la Republique du Benin
why_not: body is a poor OCR layer of a 2016 scan, unreadable for ingest; the decree predates the 2019 floor
